title: Whoever Left the Light On Demo
description: You don't know who you are. You don't know where you are. You don't know when you are. A POV surreal puzzle game where dream logic replaces the rules you know... Explore a shifting stylised world, outwit its impossible puzzles, and piece together who you were before you woke here.

title: 多元幸存者 Diverse survivors Demo
description: Diverse survivors is a 2D top-down solo ARPG horde survival game. Fight monster swarms, enchant single skills, loot random affix gear and unlock set bonuses with full armor sets. Make unique builds, explore multiverse dungeons alone and grow strong with gear enchantment systems.

title: Inferno Demo
description: Run, jump, dash, explore and FIRE in this 16-bit platformer.

title: I WILL BE THERE: Remastered Edition Demo
Shadows of Christmas Eve Demo
description: A narrative psychological horror adventure set during Christmas. Explore a nightmare, follow the clues, and find a way to escape.

title: Ubernetz Demo
description: A hacking themed turn-based strategy game demo. Write scripts to move your agent. Eliminate or make use of virus and anti-virus to take over your target's device. Then hop around the network until you find your target.

title: Eredian Stronghold Demo
description: Dive into this fast-paced ARPG where you push lanes, capture buildings, manage your economy and find legendary loot. Create your own builds and become a God of Eredian Stronghold!

title: The Ape Tales - DEMO
description: Step into the shoes of a heroic ape in The Ape Tales, an epic 2D action-adventure! Try the free demo to experience combat across different eras, unique weaponry, and intense boss battles. If you're up for the challenge, jump into The Ape Tales today!

title: For My Kingdom Demo
description: You are a medieval king. Keep your treasury, army, granary and church in balance with every decision. Repel invaders on the war map, pass the throne to your heir, grow your dynasty for generations.

title: Cluckopia Demo
description: You are Tuti, a rooster searching for his sister. The demo features the entire first valley and the first 18 missions: building rooms, farming, cooking with the hens, and a bit of combat. If you enjoy it, the full game is available to wishlist on the page.

title: MANIFEST Demo
description: This is a game about the pressure of keeping ships productive. Idle ships bleed money. Late deliveries hurt your reputation. Old hulls develop histories. Captains become known quantities. A quiet ore run can suddenly become a rescue problem, a customs problem, or a piracy problem.

title: Corner Miner Demo
description: Corner Miner is a tiny mine that lives on your desktop while you work, study, watch videos or do anything else. Keep it running in the background, check in whenever you feel like it, or take control and mine everything yourself.

title: Flippin' Bottles Demo
description: Flip bottles, stack earnings, and turn a tiny tabletop trick into an automated idle machine. Buy bigger bottles, unlock helpers and prestige for permanent upgrades.

title: REaffraid Demo
description: REAFFRAID is a THIRD person SURVIVAL HORROR game where you FIGHT Soldiers, Robots, Zombies and SEXY demon girls with powerful weapons and hand to hand fighting techniques.

title: Day 31 Demo
description: You're already infected. The suppressant is the only thing holding it back, and it runs out on Day 31. Fight through St. Harrow's Hospital wave by wave, trade nerve to a masked thing that calls itself a merchant, and try to see morning.

title: Damage Numbers Go Brr! Demo
description: Damage Numbers Go Brr! is a chill incremental auto battler. Watch small numbers turn into absurdly huge numbers as you defeat enemies, get stronger, and vibe to the music while damage numbers fill your screen.

title: Last Contract Demo
description: Last Contract is a fast-paced 2D action game set in a pixelated cyberpunk world where katanas, shurikens, and quick reflexes are your key to survival.

title: NodeRise Demo
description: Solve beam puzzles as a memory-wiped robot trapped in a mysterious system. Place and rotate nodes, activate the walls, and rise through increasingly complex levels. The NodeRise Demo includes the first 10 levels of the game.

title: Eye, caramba! (Demo)
description: The demo is the same as the base game except it has only 12 levels to solve. It also has 2 achievements.

title: Cosmo Corgis Demo
description: Scout is a terrible pilot, but he loves corgis. Gather, upgrade, repair the ship and rescue a corgi on each of the demo's 3 planets, then bring those little chaos beings home in the full game. Runs at the bottom of your desktop while you work or in a window when work is optional. Saves carry over.

title: PRIDEBLOOD -Born of Claws- Demo
description: The free demo of a monster raising and breeding sim. Play one full in-game year — 48 weeks. You never see a monster's ceiling, and you never touch a battle. Four continents, 99 rival owners, over 3,000 monsters — some 400 born the same year as yours, all ageing and competing without you.

title: Binary Proof Demo
description: Test Specialist Aaron Blonde finds himself in the midst of uncanny and strange events during a routine workday. In this facility where the boundaries of logic are pushed, he must use every detail of his environment to his advantage and overcome the obstacles to escape as soon as possible.

title: Kokoro Space Opera Demo
description: In KOKORO SPACE OPERA join an all-girl squad of galactic fighter pilots as they try to save the Earth from assured destruction. Will this wacky space adventure get a happy ending? Or is this sci-fi story secretly a tragedy? Your choices decide their fate!

title: Crystalase Demo
description: Unlock new images, explore different themes, and enjoy the rewarding process of turning scattered crystals into dazzling masterpieces.

title: IT THINKS! - Build Your Own GPU Demo
description: Play a focused, shorter version of IT THINKS! Complete 12 contracts—from your first logic gate to an early taste of parallel GPU design—and carry your progress into the full game.

title: Mind Flowers Demo
description: You are a psychologist who works nights. The man across the desk has been institutionalized for nineteen years and does not want to leave. Talk, listen, take notes and then sign. The game will never tell you who was telling the truth.

title: Stellar Embers: United Fleet Demo
description: Stellar Embers: United Fleet is a real-time space combat game with flagship piloting, fleet command & roguelike growth. Pilot your ship, direct escorts, explore random systems, refit warships, recruit captains & build a mighty fleet via dynamic missions & co-op.

title: This is not Chess, It's War! Demo
变废为宝 Trash to Cash Demo
description: Trash to Cash – a satisfying, surprising incremental trash-diving game. Rummage for treasure, and maybe you'll become the next Trash King!

title: Kick The Piñata! Demo
description: Grab your trusty bat and smash piñatas in this colorful incremental game. Buy weapons, unlock upgrades, rebirth, and build your strangely arranged home. Everything is cute, everything is fine, and the piñatas are definitely not alive.

title: Skyscraper Security: Zombie Rain Demo
description: Defend a neon megacity from zombies raining from the sky in a fast first-person action roguelike. Try all four classes, bend time, build devastating upgrades, and survive the demo's seven escalating waves.

title: Voidrunners Demo
description: Voidrunners is a space bullet heaven where you combine unique weapons, equipment, and upgrades to create powerful builds. Explore maps filled with secrets, unlock new ships, and survive endless hordes of enemies.

title: Hold the Dawn Demo
description: Build by day. Survive the horde by night. Hold the Dawn is a 3D wasteland tower defense with unique auto-fighting heroes, tactical towers, zombie waves, and co-op over Steam, LAN, or local play.

title: Get-Out-Hoomanz Demo
description: Play the unhinged Demo now! Face your friends in chaotic 2-4 player matches. Build vicious dungeon layouts, test your survival skills, and prove you're not just another human snack. Free, infinite multiplayer mayhem awaits!

title: Divine Gambit Demo
description: Defy the Gods alone or with friends and defend your village in a unique blend of action and strategy. Gather resources, place traps and fortify your land by day. At night, wield mighty weapons and spells to repel the invading armies. Overcome impossible odds and become the Protector of your people!

title: The Plunge Of Sludge Demo
description: The Plunge Of Sludge is a 2D bullet hell roguelite where you collect trinkets, weapons, and hats from a pool of over 500+ items to conquer a dungeon and defeat THE KEEPER. You will fail and perish, but every attempt will be different and more chaotic than the last. Will you take the plunge?

title: Snot Pop! Demo
description: Play the free demo of Snot Pop! Trap, pop, and splat your way through the upper levels of the slime-choked sewers in this '90s-style vertical pixel platformer. Master your snot bubbles, outmanoeuvre the first wave of vile Mouldlings, chain your clears, and prepare for the full rescue mission!

title: Hardground Demo
description: Inherit your grandfather’s neglected ranch and turn it into a thriving farming empire. Raise animals, grow crops, produce valuable goods and build your dream ranch. Explore the countryside, fish, hunt, complete quests, and work your way towards becoming a millionaire.

title: Dodgeon Demo
description: The free demo of Dodgeon, a pure-dodge neon arcade game. Two powers, three enemy types, one arena: pick your matchup and survive the flood of projectiles as long as you can. Every run is ranked, with local and online leaderboards.

title: Decontamination Protocol Demo
description: Step behind the security terminal in this tense psychological game. Review shift directives, scan incoming personnel, and make life-or-death decisions. Trust no one, and quarantine every doubt before the contagion breaches the facility.

title: Enjoy Your Stay Demo
description: Navigate the never-ending hallway of the Hudson: A hotel that doesn’t want its guests to leave. Observe your surroundings, spot irregularities, and choose the correct path to escape.

title: Marimo-VS-IAS Demo
description: This is the free demo version of "Marimo-VS-IAS: Our Friends."You can play the first chapter, try some of the training content, and explore selected areas.

title: Emojis vs Zombies Demo
description: Emojis vs Zombies is an Idle Desktop Companion Zombie Defense Game! Open packs, Collect Emoji Defenders, Upgrade your squad or base and survive endless waves even while you're AFK or working!

title: 裂光のセリアーナ Demo
description: 裂光のセリアーナは、王道ファンタジー×ナンセンスコメディのSRPGです 総勢64名の個性的なキャラクターと多彩な成長要素を駆使してステージを攻略していきます メインストーリー49マップ、エクストラマップ9マップの全58を、愉快な仲間と共に駆け抜けましょう ※体験版では合計12マップまでプレイ可能となっています※

title: Stellar End Demo
description: Free Demo version includes 4 missions, about 25% of the full version! Cool combination of classic Sci-Fi 2D "Shoot 'em up" with FPP rail shooter.

title: The Last Pillar: Hajj Demo
description: A cleaning sim unlike anything you've played before. Brush, restore and power wash your way through the sacred days of Hajj.

title: Rain of Lead Demo
description: Every hit is lethal, with no room for error. Switch between sword and pistol to tear through soldiers, artillery pieces, tanks — and even destroy an entire army. You awaken without memories. A queen claiming to be your wife asks you to fight for her. Will you stand with her to the end?

title: 廃人メダルゲーマーが勝負を挑んで来た！～メダルタワー編～ Demo
description: Let's play some medal games with your classmate, the hardcore medal game addict! But your classmate is obsessed with racking up medals. Let's show them the joy of just playing for fun.

title: ShootAndJump Demo
description: Every shot comes with recoil! This is the only rule. Survive first, then defeat more enemies. Plan each move carefully—every shot you take matters. Whether you can break through the enemy's encirclement and escape depends entirely on your skill.

title: REOGUNA Demo
description: This is the demo version of "REOGUNA." You can try out the tutorial, the early stages, and a portion of the level editor. Stage completion data can be carried over to the full version.

title: Revenant Survivors Demo
description: Revenant Survivors is a horde survival action roguelite set in a Diablo-inspired dark fantasy world. Tear through endless hordes with hard-hitting combat, absorb souls, and steal bosses' skills—even their bodies—to become evil incarnate.

title: HordeFall Demo
description: A bulletheaven x incremental game that runs as a desktop companion in the corner of your screen! While you work, your hero automatically fights thousands of enemies. Unlock upgrades and manage your economy, attributes, and spells. Your screen is your battlefield - minimal space, maximum progress!

title: Kona & SnowRabbit Demo
description: The mischievous art duo, Kona and SnowRabbit, rise to fame by pranking veteran artists until the furious “Palette Gang” strikes back. With their home in ruins, the two troublemakers set out to reclaim their stolen pride and masterpieces.

title: TimeslotTV Demo
description: TimeslotTV is personal media software that organizes your video, audio, and image files into a simulated live television experience. Create a lineup, get comfortable and channel surf to a simpler time. This is the DEMO version.

title: IJIN: History Survivors Demo
description: A Bullet Heaven fought with history's great figures — this is the demo. One figure, one battlefield: survive fifteen minutes against the horde. You only move; attacks fire on their own. All you choose is the mix of weapons and passives. Record and gold carry into the full game.

title: 阿宅的我被二次元女同事搭讪了！ Demo
description: （本作根据真实事件改编） 你是一名刚毕业的程序员阿宅，入职第一天就被二次元女同事七海强势搭讪，这位爱捉弄你的可爱坏女人，用各种甜蜜伎俩猛攻你的心房！游戏拥有29个HappyEnd，从嘴硬到心动，你能扛过几轮攻势？宅男与同事的恋爱日常，就这样开始啦！

title: IncreTop Demo
description: IncreTop is an incremental game about whipping spinning tops. You're trapped in a world of nothing but tops — whip them, earn money, upgrade, learn skills, and find a way to escape.

title: The Pink Robot Demo
description: The Pink Robot is a fast-paced isometric action roguelite with deep build variety and fluid combat. Create powerful synergies through skills and mementos, and face relentless challenges that grow stronger with every run.

title: Plague Genesis Demo
description: A 2D survival horror game in which you explore forests and dark locations, face terrifying infected creatures, and uncover the truth behind a devastating biological catastrophe.

title: Chroma Keyboard Demo
description: Four tracks and one fifteen-minute Epic from Chroma Keyboard: a calm four-key rhythm game with no fail state, where every run plays to the last note. Twelve tones folded onto four keys, each keeping its own colour.

title: 魅魔深渊：三十天生存法则 Demo
description: "魅魔深渊：三十天生存法则"是一款卡牌养成roguelike游戏。玩家可以自由组建自己的队伍，挑战不同的BOSS，拯救异世界的人民。

title: Project OC Demo
description: Project OC is a multiplayer online desktop idle game. Unlock 1000+ customization options through idle gameplay and freely mix appearances, outfits, expressions, and actions to create your unique OC.

title: Hand Stretched Demo
description: Behind the warm bricks is a tight game of precision and margins. Try your hand at managing the kitchen alone in this free single-player demo, locked to Level 1 on Easy Mode. If you enjoy the shift, please wishlist the full game for up to 3-player co-op and 6-player, 3v3 play. Steamdeck compatible!

title: Evoruption Demo
description: A dark roguelike deckbuilder where you build and evolve powerful decks, battle corrupted creatures, and master new mechanics across handcrafted story campaigns — or challenge other players in tactical 1v1 and 2v2 battles.

title: HauntedHouseNO14 Demo
description: HauntedHouseNO14 is a first‑person psychological horror game offering an immersive terrifying experience. Investigate an old unsolved case, encounter all sorts of uncanny and bizarre occurrences, and gradually unearth the dark truth that has been covered up.

title: Waifu Factory Demo
description: This is a factory game where you manage a factory creating waifus to complete requests, buy upgrades and to grow your factory to spread love to the world.

title: Auto Cats Demo
description: Auto Cats is a tactical deckbuilding roguelite where your cats never attack on their own—every hit is a card you play. Build a team, position cats on a 6×6 grid, and battle through the complete first act in this demo.

title: GHOSTNOTE Demo
description: Do The Drums Call You?Apparently when they're haunted they do.While cleaning out the attic, you find a haunted machine that plays the drums, but you have to push the right buttons for it to work. Play the notes, take the stage, set them free...

title: Aftergrowth Demo
description: Begin your journey in this focused single-player demo. Gather wood, build a simple timber shelter, and follow the road to Millbrook, the first nearby town. No upgrades—just the bare essentials of survival and building.

title: Emoji Massacre Demo
description: The free demo: fight your way to your first belt.This is the opening act of EMOJI MASSACRE — a top-down boxing game where every fighter is an emoji, and every emoji has a pair of gloves to match.WHAT YOU GET 🥊 The whole fight system, untouched — jabs, hooks, uppercuts, blocks, dodges and frame-tight parries.

title: Welcome to the Syndicate Demo
description: Rise to infamy through hits, heists, and upheaval as you build and manage your own mob of femme fatales in 1930s NYC. Will you be able to succeed against the odds and fight for those who cannot?

title: Renz Village Adventure Demo
description: An idle village simulation RPG where you build a thriving town, recruit unique heroes, send adventurers into dangerous dungeons, and watch your village grow into a legendary kingdom.

title: Flippy the Spider Demo
description: Jump, glide, and swing your way through increasingly challenging levels, eating flies and searching for your way home. Master tight, physics-based controls, explore the world, and collect trophies along the way!

title: Last Buzz Demo
description: Last Buzz is a 2–6 player Humans vs. Flies multiplayer game. Steal food, crawl on ceilings, hide in stupid places, and rescue your friends as a fly—or grab the bug spray, lock down the house, and hunt the little bastards before they take over.

title: Fathom Reach Demo
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where every run is a raid. Dive the drowned deep, build your deck on the way down, and crack a fortified base at the bottom. Free demo, unlimited dives.

title: Forsaken Fleet Demo
description: A first-person pirate horror where a haunted fisherman is drawn into the legend of the Forsaken Fleet. Follow a mysterious compass. Sail through the fog. Explore forgotten places and survive the horrors that should have stayed buried at sea.

title: Powder Inc. Demo
description: DEMO: Build a skier's Valhalla or gouge it into MEGA Resort Inc. Balance the books, weather the storms, and keep pace as the mountain demands more. The yeti's real, and it's judging you. A ski resort tycoon based on real world ski development business model, with a taste of mountain culture

title: God, Save the Queens! Demo
description: You are God. The king’s five daughters have been taken. Fight thousands of enemies, unlock powerful skills, and defeat the evil wizard Zaharad in this brutal 2.5D roguelike!

title: Super Duper Siege Demo
description: Build, defend, and upgrade your kingdom in Super Duper Siege! A tower defense roguelike where you must survive an endless onslaught from the forces of darkness.

title: 771 Demo
description: "771" is a first-person psychological horror game consisting of 7 unique gameplay segments, each created by a different developer.
developer: Admia, a1esska, 1ne2wozzz, POS, ranwoG, xetoN, MrGD

title: SANASANA Demo
description: To bring her deceased sister back to life, a young girl sets out to steal the Golden Apples from three witches. Dodge beautiful yet merciless bullet patterns in this dark fantasy bullet hell shooter filled with madness.

title: Glitch Hunter: L-Virus Outbreak Demo
description: Glitch Hunter: L-Virus Outbreak is a roguelike deckbuilder set inside a corrupted simulation. The mysterious L-Virus has infected the game world, breaking its data and turning everything into distorted low-poly fragments. Monsters, environments, and even the rules of reality have been rewritten.

title: The Die Rules All Armies: Three Kingdoms Demo
PAY THE HOUSE Demo
description: You owe The House 1,400, and the only trade you have is cigarette cards. Rip packs, complete sets, and cover a payment that comes due every two days. This demo is the whole first layer of the debt — and the first trinket you buy to survive the second. Your progress carries over.

title: God of Chaos Demo
description: Defy nature’s laws and avenge your slain pantheon! When you awake from a thousand-year slumber, will you liberate humanity or let the world burn?

title: Carom Crashers Demo
description: Bank shots beat direct hits — ×1.5 off one wall, ×2 off two. A 4-player party shooter where you read angles like billiards. Couch party: plug in a pad, press A; friends join free via Remote Play Together. Full bot matches, online quick match, 12 weapons, 6 arenas, mutators.

title: Sea Beast Odyssey Demo
description: An incremental action game set across the seas. Lead a party of 5 Heroes, upgrade your heroes and mounts, unlock 16 powerful skills, and build your skill tree as you fight through 35 levels of sea monsters. Defeat giant bosses and tame them as mounts for your next adven

title: Wild Boar Digging Demo
description: A small relaxing game where you control a wild boar collecting resources. Upgrade the attributes of you wild boar and find a diversity of interesting animal cards. You can even recruit bees to help you!

title: Thorn Beach Demo
description: DEMO — An animated puzzle from Thorn Beach! Relax while piecing together a cozy slice-of-life jigsaw featuring characters and creatures from myth and folklore.

title: BROODHOUSE Demo
description: Your deck is alive and it breeds. A creature card hits for its whole strain's population, so your power sits in the cards you never draw. The demo is one complete run — five layers, a boss, and the specimen sheet you get for finishing. 25 to 40 minutes, free.

title: Radiorizon Demo
description: Dash into this challenging 2D platformer where you visit the remains of an old star system. You cannot fight the hostile creatures, only the god-like entities that sense danger in your presence. Explore the dangerous environment, talk to the inhabitants and destroy all 3 planets to save humanity.

title: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE DEMO
description: Begin your journey with the free demo where your saved data carries over to the full game! While some level restrictions apply, you can freely explore the entire first chapter exactly as it appears in the full version.

title: Dr. Oops! Demo
description: Treat bizarre patients, solve outrageous medical mysteries, and pay off your crushing debt in this dark comedy deduction adventure! Every diagnosis relies on your observation, deduction, and some real-world knowledge. Pay off your debt, or skip a payment if needed, and fight for your freedom.

title: Stupid Never Dies: First Bite Demo
description: Turn weak zombie Davy stupid strong, stupid fast in this Blazing Fast Growth action RPG! Devour enemies, steal powers, transform, and brave a deadly dungeon to revive frozen Julia.

title: SlashZero Demo
description: SlashZero is a side-scrolling action roguelike game. As a Timehacker, your job is to travel across timelines and explore a cyberpunk world, use combat skills and strategies to piece together the truth, and take down the Lord of the Void! Is what you see the truth?

title: Emberbound Demo
description: EMBERBOUND is a furry visual novel about returning home, reuniting with old friends, and promises left unfinished. Back in his hometown to handle matters concerning his family’s old house, Yunxi faces the regrets and feelings that never truly faded.

title: Endless Mall Demo
description: Endless Mall is a roguelike city-builder card game. Carefully select your shops, mind your layout, build a powerful economic engine, and rake in profits beyond your wildest imagination!

title: More Slots More Money Demo
description: A short incremental casino management game where you fill the floor with slot machines and table games, hire staff, expand to new rooms, and upgrade towards the ultimate automated casino.

title: My Fairy Princess Demo
description: My Fairy Princess is a life sim set in an Eastern fantasy world, featuring multiple endings. You take on the role of a parent, raising your daughter in a fabled realm of spiritual beauty and tranquility. How will you guide your daughter into an uncertain future?

title: Astral Enterprises Demo
description: As CEO, build a ruthless corporate empire! Solve spatial factory puzzles, master complex supply chains, and manipulate dynamic markets to maximise profit. Mobilise local workforces, fund high-tech R&D, and construct colossal megaprojects to satisfy your demanding Parent Company.

title: Fall, Fall, Fall for you Demo
Swarm Harvest Demo
description: Congratulations, you're hired! Blast bugs, deploy defensive towers, and command a pack of powerful attack drones to carve through endless alien swarms. Evolve into an unstoppable bug-blasting machine with absurdly overpowered builds to generate massive profits and make the corporation proud.

title: 世外桃源 Demo
description: 这是一款夜店模拟经营游戏，但是无需对店铺进行管理，而是着重于满足顾客的需求。每个顾客有需求和偏好，只有满足需求的员工才可以接待这名顾客，如果满足了偏好则可以获得额外的打赏。 商业竞争：和其它夜店进行PK，获胜可获得新员工和服装。 丰富的服装：每个员工都有漂亮的服装，可随时更换，同时顾客偏好也有服装，穿着相应的服装可以获得打赏。

title: Boom Boom No Guess Minesweeper DEMO
description: Classic MineSweeper meets intense dungeon combat! Explore mysterious magic towers, encounter bizarre monsters, and collect powerful items. Featuring unique mine-sweeping battle mechanics, every step of deduction is crucial!

title: Fly&Goal Demo
description: A casual puzzle game where you play disc golf while navigating holes that showcase the changing seasons. Read the wind to choose your throw, dodge obstacles, and aim to clear all 12 courses, each with 9 holes.

title: PHAGE Demo
description: "Phage" is a pixel-art platformer. Players control a weak primitive organism called the "Phage", whose only ability is to steal the bodies of other creatures on the map—each with unique traits and powers.

title: Match-3 Live Stream Demo
description: Match-3 Live Stream is a roguelike game where you play as a streamer. Dance on stream, earn likes, follows, donations and other rewards by matching tiles, and collect new viewers and other pieces to build your deck. Each piece has a unique function.

title: SOGUL: Den of the Deep Demo
Backlot: Hollywood Studio Tycoon Demo
description: A deep Hollywood studio simulation, 1930 to the streaming age. A back lot, a million dollars and no pictures. Commission scripts, sign stars to seven-year contracts, book dates against rival studios, and survive television, home video and everything else that came for the movies.

title: Temple 13 - Time Collapse Demo
description: A first-person game where you explore a mysterious ancient temple and search for anomalies. Carefully observe your surroundings, spot changes, and determine what has changed. As you progress, the anomalies become increasingly dangerous, leading you deeper into a mysterious labyrinth.

title: Strange Tales from Republican China Demo
description: The demo includes the game's prologue and is available for free.

title: Valorwood (Early Access) Demo
description: Valorwood is a multiverse fantasy survival RPG built in Unreal Engine 5. Explore the Overworld, battle enemies, mine gemstones, craft, build bases and fly broomsticks. This Alpha showcases the core game while characters, animations and future realms remain in development.

title: Cirtemin Demo
description: Prove your worth on the endless battlefield—as long as someone is still standing, the fight goes on.

title: HEARKEN Demo
description: A blind co-op horror-comedy for 2-4 players. Sound is your only sight — every whisper, footstep, and shout lights up the dark, and calls the monster that hunts by ear. Sneak, haul cargo, and scream at exactly the wrong moment.

title: Eternal Rift Defense Demo
description: The first eleven rifts of Eternal Rift Defense, free and fully offline. Play a hero on the field, raise your towers, hunt your first gear, and hold the line against Vaelgrym's legions. No account, no connection, no catch.

title: 墨守 Demo
description: 東洋ハイファンタジーの世界で、防衛成功まで何度も時を巻き戻す高難易度２Ｄタワーディフェンス。 さらにゲーム内のステージ作成機能により、プレイヤーの数だけ終わりないステージが待っている。 デモ版でも20時間以上遊べるボリュームたっぷりなゲーム。

title: Paint The World Demo
description: Everything starts white. The buildings, the streets, the trees, the cars parked at the curb - a whole little town with no color in it. What you do about that is up to you.You point at something and paint the exact spot you're looking at, and the color stays. Simple enough. But paint a tree all the way and it starts swaying in the wind.

title: Puzzle Loot Demo
description: A 7×7 tap puzzle roguelite RPG. Defeat monsters by clearing blocks, choose from 25 classes, collect and forge gear, and reincarnate through New Game+ toward the Demon Lord's Castle and beyond. Easy to pick up, deep enough to master, with a bounty system that changes how you play.

title: Bato Battle Demo
description: Bato Battle is a chaotic submarine party combat game for 2-8 players. Pilot a whale, ram a shark, dive like a dolphin, and torpedo your friends across a pile of ridiculous gamemodes and maps!

title: Sluice That Goose! Demo
description: An incremental game where you sluice huge flocks of gooses and farm their loot to further enhance your goose sluicing behaviors. Unlock powerful upgrades, discover hidden events, and SLUICE. MORE. GOOSE.

title: Magic Chess - 魔法象棋 Demo
BATTLEFRONTS: GRIMDARK Demo
description: Mostly same gameplay than the core paid game, just with less aesthetic options.

title: TCG Card Chaos Demo

description: An elite military team is sent to recover a specimen that could change everything. As the sole survivor, you must restore power, unlock new routes, reactivate critical systems, and uncover why someone wanted the mission buried.

description: Starting in the year 1401, Crowns of Medieval Europe is a turn-based grand strategy game. Lead one of 10 historical kingdoms, manage your resources, purchase vital goods from the market, master diplomacy, and march your armies to unify 15th-century Europe!

title: Skippy's Grand Escape Demo
description: Escape increasingly complex mazes as fast as possible. Select skills tactically for each level. Optimize your path. Watch out for enemies, traps, anomalies and more in this space themed top down maze runner.

title: Tiny Garden Café Demo
description: Sow seeds and nurture them, harvest fresh ingredients to cook meals, and serve them to your guests. As the seasons turn and dusk falls, the café lights glow—enjoy a peaceful day in your very own little garden café.

title: Stories of Somnia Demo
description: Stories of Somnia is an exploration-first JRPG with the bones of a Metroidvania. Use spells to grapple across gaps, change the rules of combat, and reshape the world around you. Collect memory-born companions called Dreamkin and uncover a story about grief, time, and the courage to rest.

Lone Tower Demo
description: Defend one tower. Face endless waves. Build synergies, unlock permanent upgrades, and survive the chaos.

description: Avoid or confront invisible entities while exploring, solving puzzles, and overcoming horrors to to pay off your debt. Use special goggles, a taser gun, and your wits to survive the night.

title: Solitaire: Kingdom in Chains Demo
description: A dark fairytale solitaire adventure. Help Patch break Mordrake’s curse across 90 handcrafted levels, defeat bizarre bosses, wield magical powers, and unlock beautiful decks, card backs and worlds along the way.

title: Untold Memories: Obsession Demo
description: Play as police officer Nathan Mercer in a story-driven psychological horror game. Explore a quiet home, uncover disturbing clues, piece together the events of the night, and unravel the mystery before the past closes in.

title: Warehouse Bots Demo
description: Get an early look at Warehouse Bots with this free demo. Build your first warehouse, organize storage, unlock basic licenses, and manage a growing fleet of delivery robots.The demo includes the opening campaign levels and a small sandbox where you can experiment with layouts, traffic flow, and automation.

title: KABUKI FIRE: DOJO Demo
description: Score as many points as possible within a limited time frame and break the global high-score in this charming but challenging arcade shoot 'em up!!

title: WILDERLOCKE Demo
description: WILDERLOCKE is a tactical monster-taming roguelike. Build up a team of diverse & powerful monsters. Find the perfect combinations of moves, passives & stats to create devastating synergies. Triumph in increasingly challenging 2v2 turn-based battles and become unstoppable.

title: PUGAD Demo
description: PUGAD is a spearfishing horror game set on a secluded island in the Philippines. As a newbie diver, learn to hunt fish, upgrade your equipment, hone your diving skills, and discover what lurks in the depths.

title: Renewed: Create Sustainable Power Demo
description: Renewed: Create Sustainable Power is a first-person simulation game where players build and manage their own renewable energy community through the design, construction, and configuration of battery systems, solar infrastructure, and sustainable power networks.

title: Shatterswarm Demo
description: The Voxan Empire bears it's iron teeth and sends fleet after fleet of terrifying space abominations at you. Defend your colony. Defend humanity!

title: Terminidle Demo
description: Terminidle is an incremental hacking game about mining data from a bare terminal. Grow botnets, automate everything, and run hack contracts under a timer. This demo runs from your very first byte to the moment your terminal boots a desktop OS.

No Death No Life Demo

title: Soul Link - End and Rebirth Demo
PROXY Demo
description: Battle through a chaotic, high-tech alien world in this fast-paced top-down roguelike shooter – with friends or solo. Master intense bullet-hell combat and stack unique items to unleash devastating, game-breaking combos.

title: 仙路烟尘 Demo
description: Path of Immortal Dust is a text-based cultivation sim. Train your techniques, break through realms, and explore a world of sect politics and turn-based combat. Every action costs time. Every choice shapes your fate. Immortality is but a thought away.

title: Another Eden Begins Demo
description: Embark on a time-traveling RPG adventure featuring command battles presented by Masato Kato, creator of numerous RPG classics.

title: Ironholm: Reign of the Isles Demo
Bad Pig House Demo
description: You lost your piggy family... Rebuild your home to stay safe.

description: Travel between five distinct cities, trade across shifting markets, gather intelligence, bid at auctions, explore the black market, research rare artifacts, and hire specialists to strengthen your enterprise. In Roads Beneath the Crown, every deal and decision shapes the merchant you become.

description: This is a free demo for "HIJURA SCARLET GEAR". In this demo, you can play the early stage and experience the core action gameplay.

description: An ASCII-style endless arcade crawler. Using a unique Minesweeper-inspired reveal mechanic to navigate random generated dungeons while engaging in frantic, high-speed arcade combat.

description: Stack. Mislead. Wipe them out. A punishing tower defense about building a fortress out of stacked blocks. Every tower is a weapon, a wall, and a piece of terrain that leads enemies astray. Let 50 through and it is over.

description: ASHEN is a top-down pixel art action RPG set after a solar apocalypse. Dodge and chain attacks against creatures born from the Cinder, forge your build with no fixed class, then farm, fish and cook to rebuild what's left of Braseval.

title: Demon Baby Demo
description: Play the first day of the full game in either story mode, arcade mode or speedrun mode

title: Wasteland Future Demo
description: The apocalypse has come, and the world has become a silent graveyard. Seek powerful companions, and unleash their abilities through the dice in your hand. Roll a hopeful future.

NIGHT DEVOURESS Demo
description: Casual Horror Action RPG "NIGHT DEVOURESS" – Exorcism? Physical is trending!

title: Crooked Derby Demo
description: Bet in secret, lie in public, and rig the race. Play a free demo of Crooked Derby, a turn-based digital board game of bluffing, deduction, and underhanded horse-race manipulation.

title: Frontier Tale Demo
description: Frontier Tale is a cozy adventure farming game that blends extraction-style gameplay with town building. Forge weapons, explore a charming cel-shaded fantasy world, gather rare resources, recruit unique companions, and build your dream frontier from the ground up.

title: STEEL GULLET Demo
description: Build a massive factory aboard a moving ark. Melt, separate, and refine chaotic scrap using realistic thermodynamics. Process materials by mass instead of items, craft based on material properties, and optimize complex production lines in strictly limited space.

description: A synthwave space tile‑breaker. Hit the ball. Stack powerup cards at the right moments to clear the screen in the fastest time. Or just chill and space out to the synthwave soundtrack beats.

description: Story-driven AVG with puzzles and multiple endings. Trapped in a twisted otherworld high school, survive deadly divine trials. Explore locations, collect clues to uncover dark campus secrets amid lies and betrayal. Your choices shift bonds, expose truths and decide who survives.

title: Vanguard's Descent Demo
description: A rogue-like RPG focused on player teambuilding, dungeon progression, and a unique spin on action combat. Recruit members of the Vanguard, humanity's last hope and journey across various lands to defeat the evil that is the Plagued.

title: Adverse Action Demo
description: A machine refused four thousand applications last night and will not say why. The law says a person must. Read the file, find the reason the record can actually support, cite it, and sign your name to it. This demonstration copy carries Act I: six shifts at Desk 9.

title: Type the World Demo
description: Learn to type on a keyboard with all ten fingers by typing the world map. Learn geography. That’s it, that’s the game. For kids and grownups.

title: Sitter Demo
description: Investigating the mysterious death of his grandmother, a detective breaks into her home to discover the truth, but the dwelling begins to play tricks on him. The space breaks, fears become flesh, and there is still no way out. Every step, every new room, every cycle is a chance to go mad.

title: The Earth Is Flat Demo
description: Teddy is a 40-year-old conspiracy addict who decides to prove the Earth is flat after getting dumped. This demo includes the first level, a chaotic glimpse into the madness, dark humor, and bizarre challenges that await in the full game.

title: Coliseum Slap Demo
description: Administra tu propio coliseo en este simulador de física en primera persona. Captura gladiadores, lánzalos a la arena, desbloquea mejoras y graba tu propia voz para escuchar cómo reaccionan durante la partida.

title: Parry Dungeon Demo
description: Demo to gather feedback about Parry Dungeon's game loop so full release is as fun as possible. Kill monsters using a parry-focused physics-based combat system as you crawl (massacre) the Goblin Cave.

title: RhythMania Demo
description: A vibrant rhythm anthology with one-button mini-games, colorful art, and a wide range of Brazilian musical styles!

title: Tumble: A Cozy Dice Roguelite Demo
description: Tumble's first act, free: five dice, a familiar scorecard, and a shop that breaks the house rules. Two dice sets, fifteen charms, and a boss waiting at ante 4 - win to open a higher stake. Wishlist the full game for all five sets, 53 charms, and endless mode.

title: While 1 Demo
description: Don't touch the walls. While 1 is a minimalist mouse-only action game centered around this simple concept. Create a loop around the level while avoiding obstacles synchronized to the music.

title: Mega Hasan 2: Wallet Detective Demo
description: Mega Hasan is back! This time he's here to find other people's crap. Run and jump through 56 levels across 7 worlds. Battle bosses, unlock characters and team up with a friend in local co-op!

title: Dead Relay Demo
description: Dead Relay is a PSX-style survival horror game. As a field engineer sent to a blacked-out relay station, you must restore power, explore classified sectors, and decode encrypted logs. But the facility isn't empty — and the system itself seems to be watching your every step.

title: Artia and the Tower of Trolls Demo
Cartagol: Football Card Career Demo
description: Live the life of a footballer and play every match with cards. This free demo covers the first half of your debut season - card matches, jokers, transfers and all. Your progress carries over to the full game.

title: Goodly Trials Demo
description: Check out the Goodly Trials free demo to see if you are interested in the full game!

title: Sakura Shiren Demo
description: Hold out against endless waves of anime yokai with up to 7 friends. Draft run-changing blossom buffs between waves, spend petals on weapons and upgrades, and face 25 hand-drawn bosses that scale to your squad. Demo stops at wave 10

title: The Sounding Dark Demo
description: Blind things hunt this crypt by sound. So do you. Every step you take lights the dark for a heartbeat and tells them exactly where you are. Six levels. Three hunters. Headphones on.

title: Swap Attack Demo
description: Both halves of your cell move as one, in two arenas at once, sharing a single gun. Whoever holds it fights; whoever doesn't, runs. Sling it over the divider before the far side gets overrun. Twenty rounds to the Gatekeeper, then endless.

title: Soldier Rush Demo
description: Soldier Rush Demo is a top-down auto-shooter roguelite: dodge waves while your gun auto-fires at the nearest enemy, spend money in a shop between waves, and fight through to your first boss. Get a taste of Prestige and the Crystal Shop before the demo ends.

title: Soul Finders Demo
description: Play one complete round of Soul Finders, a competitive supernatural multiplayer game where you collect and bank souls while surviving werebears, deadly weather, and UFOs.

title: Pocket Adventurer Demo
description: Your desktop's tiniest hero. A cozy idle RPG that lives at the bottom of your own screen. Delve dungeons, collect companions, and retire legends while you work. No servers, no season pass, yours forever.

title: Renz Tower Defense Demo
description: Fast-paced minimalist tower defense featuring upgradeable towers, economy management, and escalating enemy waves.

description: Blast through a ridiculous pixel-art Wild West in BWAG, a fast-paced vertical-scrolling arcade shooter. Dodge bullets, gun down angry vegetables, chase high scores, hit Cheekpoints, and get a taste of the crude comedy and chaos of the full game.

title: Beltrunner Demo
description: Fly, dodge, salvage, repeat. Beltrunner is a sci-fi bullet-hell horde-survival roguelite: your guns fire themselves while you drift-dodge asteroids, hazards and pirate raiders. Draft 20+ weapons, fuse maxed ones into screen-clearing evolutions, and tear down multi-phase bosses solo or in co-op.

title: Wait, Cards I Memorized? Demo
description: A memory training game based on the Memory Palace technique. Memorize 13 cards using 13 body hooks. Each card links to an image matching its suit's first letter. More modes are planned: voice control, visual novel, and shoot-em-up.

title: Laser Connect Demo
description: A challenging sci-fi puzzle game where you rotate and snap mirrors, guide laser beams, and beat the clock across complex levels.

title: Nightwatch at The Museum Demo
description: A routine night shift at an old Javanese museum. A fire from 1990 that nobody talks about. And something, or someone that refuses to let the truth stay buried.

title: BONEBUILDER Demo
description: In this action roguelike you will fight imposing enemies in heavy, deliberate third-person 3D action combat. Collect bones and weapons from defeated enemies to build the most powerful skeleton possible through BONEBUILDER's unique crafting and talent systems!

description: Society has fallen. BILLIONS must die. Do you have what it takes to save the world from the soypocalypse or will nothing ever happen again?

title: Pocket Racer Shop Sim Demo
description: Create the ultimate Pocket Racer hobby shop. Stock the shelves, open car packs, build miniature race cars and expand your store over time. Design custom tracks and invite your friends over to help run the shop or to throw down on the latest track setup.

title: Just another Tank game Demo
description: A local free-for-all tank brawl. Two to four tanks fight through procedurally built arenas in six worlds, each hull carrying its own second weapon. Play a friend or fill the seats with bots — then take one tank through a 300-level solo campaign and spend the winnings in the garage.

title: Bang Bang Boom Pow Demo
description: Become the greatest gunslinger in the West in this first-person BOSS RUSH with roguelike elements, where the fastest trigger wins. Face unique duelists with their own skills and mysteries, or challenge friends in split-screen. HAND-DRAWN!

title: Bumper Bout Demo
description: Competitive PvP pinball! Defend your drain while scoring points to send more trouble at your opponent. Play Local Versus or battle the CPU across two stages with Nova and Redjack in this free Bumper Bout demo.

title: DwarVein Demo
description: Welcome to DwarVein, a world where you, a trusty dwarf venture forth into inhabited caves on the search for valuable Gems. Careful though, there are creatures lurking in the dark abyss. They have stolen your trusted companions and hid them within the caves! Will you achieve the highest score!?

title: CACTBOY Demo
description: Put on your sheriff hat and load your revolver! CACTBOY is a hilarious and chaotic Western multiplayer party game for up to 4 players. From split-second quick-draw duels to absurd brawls, master a variety of minigames and prove who the true CACTBOY is!

title: TALAKA Demo
description: Slash, shoot, and restore myths and beasts in fluid, fast roguelite combat through a stunning hand-drawn watercolor world, where legends and even Orishas are going rogue in fear of being forgotten.

title: SagoCat Demo
description: A cat lives in your computer. It stays up when you work late and joins in when you curse your boss. Your music? "That's what you're listening to?" — it grumbles, then stays till the song ends. Give it time and it becomes the one you want next to you. It keeps a diary. You're allowed to read it.

title: Duat: Beyond Light & Shadow Demo
description: The mystical Egyptian underworld beckons you in Duat: Beyond Light & Shadow! Foil the plans of Set and Apep using your powers of light. Explore the varied environments of the underworld and battle your way through in this epic pixel art style Metroidvania.

title: The Black Breath Demo
description: Lead a caravan of survivors fleeing from the Black Breath. Manage your resources, explore, and choose your path carefully, as the journey will be unforgiving. When hardships arise, you will rely on a diverse group of heroes willing to give their lives to defend the caravan.

title: Heroic Gambit Demo

title: Ages TD Demo
description: A story-driven TOWER DEFENSE inspired by Warcraft 3 custom games. Hold the road as the horde grows from runners to armored packs to warlords on both paths at once. The demo has the tutorial and three campaign levels, plus online PvP where the horde is yours to send.

description: Imprisoned by the king, you must earn your freedom by completing his puzzle trials. A top-down 2D puzzle game focused on logic, planning, limited items, and clever solutions.

title: Sword Saint Soriel Demo
description: An RPG focused on exploration, quests and combat. Shape the fate of the amnesiac Sword Saint who must find her way back to the Allmother.

Dice Showdown Demo

title: 1000 Days with My Kid's Concert Band Demo
The Clock the Queen and the Door on the Beach Demo

description: Face mythical legends in a Southeast Asia-inspired world action-adventure soulslike. title: CURSECADE: Pachinko Roguelite Demo
description: Build explosive chain reactions with balls, pegs, and cards inside a cursed arcade machine. Place and upgrade special pegs, master physics-driven bounces, and survive stages and bosses that keep rewriting the rules.

title: Little Bettas Demo

title: Only Love Opening Chests Demo

description: Control a living warrior on wheels in a procedural off-road RPG: fight, choose, uncover the hidden, and survive in the beautiful yet brutal Dead World.

title: Summoner's Legacy Demo

description: Your master got pulled into a crystal, so go get him back. A simple, chunky survivor roguelite where your knight swings on his own and you decide what he swings with. Blend fire, frost and lightning into every hit and fight through five biomes.

title: 口袋修仙 Demo
description: Pocket Cultivation is a strategy cultivation game centered around “Storage Bag Building.” Journey through a vast world of cultivation, collect items that suit your path, and carefully arrange them within the limited slots of your storage bag.

title: Pickup Station Simulator Demo
description: Pick it, Shelve it, Scan it, Deliver it, Ship it — Grow a corner parcel point into a local logistics empire.

description: Build stellar rollercoasters across alien worlds, carve tunnels through planets, and launch trains into orbit. Customize every track element, scenery decoration, and environment before subjecting riders to the forces of the universe! The galaxy is your theme park!
