Every run brings new chefs, recipes, and items. Discover hidden synergies, master different strategies, unlock multiple endings!

title: Mo Wu Tian Gong Demo
description: Game name: Mo Wu Tian Gong Demo, the game belongs to the Chinese style soul fighting game, and is a mixed type game with survival architecture game. This is a trial version, and the model pixels will be lower than the genuine version.

title: Punch Rock Demo
description: A lone climber wanders a mountain in a small window on the edge of your screen, a dog at her heel. Give her the day: forage, chop, mine, climb, or rest, and then get back to work. She's further up every time you look.

title: Incremortal: Xianxia Ascension Demo
description: An incremental game about Xianxia cultivation. Slay monsters, gather spiritual qi, refine elixirs, break through realms, and ascend to immortality.

title: Peach Garden Survivors Demo
description: Peach Garden Survivors: Restore the Han is a Three Kingdoms–themed survivor action game. Lead the heroes of Liu Bei’s cause through armies of enemies, build powerful weapon and gear combinations, forge legendary arms, unleash Oath skills, and fight to restore the Han.

title: DinoBoxDemo
description: Drop and merge cute dinosaurs to evolve them in this addictive physics puzzle! Every 20 turns, a meteor strikes, vaporizing whichever dino it lands on. Collect real trivia in your dino encyclopedia and unlock exciting new eras!

title: Cursed and Fading Demo
description: Find the lich that has cursed you and defeat them! Use your stats wisely, for they are also your lifeblood. Every movement costs you something. Start strong and fight your way across Small, Medium, and Large map sizes. When you die, respawn as one of the six classes and try again. Break your curse!

title: Undermoon Demo
description: UnderMoon is a dark fantasy turn-based tactical roguelike RPG. Awaken in a strange moonlit town, build your hero, and climb a shifting tower. Read enemy intent, combine weapons, magic, summons, and elemental reactions, defeat deadly bosses, and uncover why everyone was brought to this world.

title: Domino Descent Demo
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where your deck is a box of dominoes. Chain them, paint them, curse them, and build a multiplier that runs away with itself. Twelve floors down, something is waiting on every third one. The stairs keep going after that.

title: Irish Sport Manager Demo
description: Take one of eight counties through a full season of the Gaelic games: football, hurling, camogie or ladies' football. The league, the championship under the 2026 rules, the club final, and a county board that delivers its verdict at the end. The whole game, one year deep.

title: Numble Demo
description: Play the classic 3-digit mode for as long as you like and test whether you have what it takes to be a codebreaker!

title: Millennium Slumber Demo
description: Survive 400,000 years on a planet infested with an alien calamity! Gather resources, build a base and defend against hordes of nocturnal monsters in this rogue-like with cryostasis mechanics.

title: Beat Bots Demo
description: A casual musical puzzle game - make beats with bots! Listen to the target beat, then solve how to replicate the beat by manipulating bots that each represent a different drum sound

title: Sweeplings Demo
description: A cute logic puzzle about scanning the board to find Starlings and avoid Boomlings. English UI · No spoken dialogue. If you love logic puzzles like Minesweeper but want something warmer and more visual — with clues on the board instead of numbers — Sweeplings is for you.

title: Moose Builders Demo
description: Dig sand with a shovel and process into iron, silicon and more. Craft and merge better tools and machines to build solar panels to power them. Research new machines to automate everything in multi-story factories. Play alone or with friends to survive in the desert and turn it into a solar farm.

title: Shattered Void Online Demo
description: Free to Play: Command powerful capital ships in fast-paced 5v5 space combat. Choose from five ship classes — from nimble Interceptors to massive Carriers — capture sectors, outmaneuver your enemies, and dominate the void.

title: Blade & Burgers Demo
description: Make burgers, whale in a pay-to-win game, and simp your heart out in this parody roguelite made as a “love” letter to mobile microtransaction grindfests. It’s not the Darkest Dungeon. It’s the greediest one.

title: Assassin Seek Demo
description: A real Hide-AND-Seek game, AssassinSeek is multiplayer stealth PvP game where every player is an assassin hiding in a crowd of identical villagers. Spot who moves like a human, assassinate, and vanish before the next hunter finds you.

title: Debt Crystal Adventure Demo
description: Fear creates strong will—and “they” are watching. They offer contracts: wishes come true, but debt follows. Meow Meow signed out of fear of poverty; Awo Awo chose the chains. No call to save the world—just an adventurer repaying debt, uncovering deeper rules through quests and choices.

title: Party Tycoon: Takeover Demo
description: The opening stretch of the full game, and all of the loop that runs underneath it. Book tonight's event, put crew on the floor, open the doors, and hold the room together until the lights come up - then spend what came through the door on a better night.

title: Red Glare The Reckoning Demo
description: 1946. The Reich has fallen. The hunt begins. Track escaped Nazi officers across 7 missions. New commando Fritz the dog, two new enemy types, Roguelike Mode, Fog of War Mode and enhanced weather. Standalone — no base game required. Justice has no borders.

title: Veiled Shadows Demo
description: Live a month in a rural mountain town, build bonds, and hunt a mystery across two worlds. Manage your days, explore dungeons, and fight turn-based battles to recover what's been lost. The Veiled Shadows demo covers first few in-game days.

title: Dark Monastery Demo
description: Explore a dark fantasy world in this 2D Action RPG with metroidvania exploration, challenging boss fights, deep character progression, crafting, enchanting, and powerful loot to discover.

title: Guardian Above the Domes Demo
description: Guardian Above the Domes is a real-time artillery game built around realistic orbital mechanics. Bombard the enemy from a lone space station, defend the last domed cities on an airless planet, and uncover its lost history alongside a cat-shaped AI.

title: Momotaro and the Oni Island Demo
description: Join Momotaro on his journey to the Oni King. Match orbs to attack, exploit Fire, Water, and Plant weaknesses, fight alongside your companions, and choose your own path across the island.

title: Epoch Forge Demo
description: The world broke a long time ago and kept going anyway. Mining, settlements, circuitry, gods and ships all run at once, in one world, and none of them wait for you. Talk to anyone — they answer in their own words, from a model running on your machine, about things that actually happened.

title: Museum Disarter Demo
description: The Museum is a complete disARTer! Organize hundreds of paintings, figure out which absurdly informal description belongs to each artwork, and restore order to the gallery. Deduce and sort in this cozy single-player first-person simulator.

title: Lightbound Demo
description: A racing platformer. Take control of a ball and set off on a wildly dangerous adventure. Master your momentum, chain power-ups, outwit the enemies on your tail, and whatever you do — don't fall. Play Solo with the demo version.

title: Escape With Friends Demo
description: Investigate with your friends in this hilarious hand drawn game. Draw your own skin and go on a journey filled with minigames: darts, mini car races, electrical panels... From 2 to 8 players.

title: Index 1391 Demo
description: In this techno-gothic roguelike deckbuilder, journey to the heart of a twisted Sanctum to destroy the VIRUS infecting your faith. Wield sacred cards to defeat corrupted foes, build a powerful deck, and equip rule-altering Doctrines that reshape the rules of combat.

title: Trials of the cabin Demo
description: Trials of the Cabin is a Sokoban puzzle game where the robots only act after you.

title: Emberhaven Demo
description: Survive in a procedurally generated fantasy world overrun by creeping corruption. Build impenetrable strongholds, tend your farms, forge deadly weapons, and fend off hordes of mutated abominations to defend your last sanctuary.

title: Ward 9 Demo
description: Enter Ward 9 as an Aide and interview David Carver, a patient who knew impossible details about his family's disappearance. Read the record, choose your pressure point, expose contradictions, and reach the first breakthrough in this psychological horror investigation.

title: PETNAROK Demo
description: Autobattler animal roguelite inspired by Super Auto Pets & Balatro. Merge animals, apply Fruit & Veggie buffs, and discover powerful synergies.

title: Card Shop Duelist Demo
description: Run your own trading card shop. Rip packs chasing the big pull, price the shelves, hire staff, and duel your customers in Battleforge, a full TCG built into the game. This free demo covers your shop's first full Spring season, and your save carries straight into the full game.

title: Kasane Demo
description: The demo for Kasane, a puzzle about layering colors to recreate a target pattern exactly. Red, blue and yellow blend where they overlap, and the same color layered twice cancels out and vanishes. Every puzzle has exactly one solution. Twelve puzzles - three from each of the four tiers.

title: Tales of Acilain : Bound by Shadow Demo
description: Delve into treacherous subterranean ruins. Master elemental powers, wield your blade in fast-paced combat, and hurl objects to solve ancient dungeon puzzles. Conquer colossal bosses and uncover buried secrets.

title: En Garde Gambit Demo
description: A turn-based tactical roguelite where you and your enemies plan predictively for simultaneous resolution. Every move and attack resolve at once. Outwit enemies in various maps, with various skills/upgrades, in Singleplayer, co-op, and PvP.

title: Overdue Demo
description: This is the free demo of OVERDUE — the full three-night shift. Co-op horror for 1–4 players. Work the night shift at a small-town library in the year 2000: help patrons, shelve returns, and photograph anything that isn't the way you left it. Three nights. Most don't do three.

title: CatchUp Showdown Demo
description: A demo for a co-op catch game for up to 6 players. You and your friends throw around a ball in increasingly harder stages trying to rack up points in order to get to the top of the tower (only up to 2nd level in demo)

title: The Last Brazilian Demo
description: Choose from five combatants and cross eight fantastical regions of Brazil. Battle enemy hordes and eight bosses in this 2D action beta, featuring fixed difficulty and one curated version of each stage. Master unique abilities and prove you can become The Last Brazilian.

title: ChickenScratch: Cluck & Code Demo
description: You don't steer the chicken. You program it. Write real scripts in a fake desktop OS and send your bird into fields that reseed every run, so hardcoded coordinates work exactly once. Upgrades aren't +1% damage: they're if statements, for loops, and the memory to hold a list.

title: Salty: Evolution Simulator Demo
description: Salty is an evolution game seen through a microscope. Guide one cell from a simple prokaryote to complex multicellular life: craft organelles, fight off invading viruses, outgrow rival cells, and evolve toward the day you divide and become multicellular.

title: March of the Red Queen Demo
Sticky Rooms Demo
description: Rug first or table first? Sticky Rooms is a room decorating game where the furniture is stickers, the order of placement is a puzzle, and mistakes can't be undone. Follow Clara's adventures: from uninspired office worker to renowned interior designer.

title: BOOMER Demo
description: BOOMER is a chaos-filled co-op horror game for up to 6 players. Inhabit a zany cast of customizable puppet characters as you explore derelict environments, encounter forgotten monsters and play a deadly game of hot potato with everyone's favorite little rascal, Boomer!

title: BRAVERY Demo
description: Explore the basement as Bravery, a tiny hero in a human-sized world. Recover your equipment, gather resources, light candles, use matches wisely, and survive the cockroaches in this first playable glimpse of BRAVERY.

title: RatSpire Demo
description: RatSpire（鼠之尖塔）is a roguelike game of tower exploration and squad-based combat. As the King of the Mice, lead your followers into the unknown, gather relics, solve puzzles, and fight your way upward. Grow stronger through failure and rebirth. Every run is a new challenge.

title: See the sky Demo
description: Sometimes the only way to rewrite the past is to relive it. A visual novel in the genre of detective and psychological thriller, where you do not investigate crimes but the psyche and memories of the main characters.

title: Ember's Oath Demo
description: Play as Ember, a fire mage with the unique ability to transform herself into a phoenix. In a world where mages have been hunted to extinction, you must master the synergy between your human spells and phoenix powers in order to defeat your foes in this third-person, combat-focused fantasy adventure!

title: The Goblin Path Demo
description: A single-player action RPG about a goblin serving the Demon King. Scout the next party at night, steal their gear, and prepare poisons and traps. By day, defend your lair and loot the heroes you defeat.

title: Village Incremental Demo
description: Village Incremental is an incremental game where you harvest resources and grow your village and research tools.

title: Grandma's Guide to the Grand Outside Demo
description: Grandma calls for aid! Well… she wants a visit, but she lives in the middle of nowhere. Pack wisely, step into the wilderness, and see if you can reach her!

title: Colsword Demo
description: COLSWORD is a logic puzzle game where you paint cubes in the right sequence using enchanted colored swords.

title: Halsey Row Demo
description: The first two weeks in a shop that buys and sells human memory. Appraise what people bring, decide what it is worth, and find out what your word is worth. A demo of Halsey Row.

title: Dancing Wings - The Aerobatic Simulator Demo
description: Team aerobatics flight simulator - do it solo. Fly, save the replay, fly in overlay mode, save the new replay, and repeat it up to six aircrafts. Realistic aerodynamics and landscape. Step-by-step training. Share your replay online.

title: BERGWERK - A Mining Sim Demo
description: Build your own mining company in the coal region of Grubental! Construct your colliery above ground, descend into procedurally generated depths, and operate over 15 heavy machines. Master mine statics, infrastructure, complex transport networks, and sell your coal on dynamic markets.

title: Strayward Demo
description: STRAYWARD is an open-world voxel survival game set across a series of strange and isolated regions. Explore, scavenge, gather resources, build shelters, and fight to survive as you venture deeper into an unfamiliar world filled with persistent threats and unexplained phenomena.

title: Casino Coral Demo
description: Enter the Casino Coral and see if you can get on Lady Luck's good side. Win big by playing a game developed by the Coral snake family. With unique gameplay and characters around every corner you will get lost in the world as you take on the Gauntlet, testing your mastery over the cards.

title: Mineblader - Spin. Mine. Upgrade. Demo
description: This is the demo for Mineblader: a short but packed incremental game where you use a spinning top (spinner) to mine, make money, upgrade, get special powers, and defeat bosses. Wishlist the full game to get notified when it comes out!

title: Egg Rush Demo
description: Egg Rush is a 3D cartoon side-scrolling Rogue-lite game. Discover a wealth of treasures and items to power up, master diverse characters to unleash creative combos, and take on formidable monsters to prove your might. Even more eggs await you ahead!

title: Medimon Demo
description: A medical monster-taming RPG where you collect creatures inspired by cells, organs, diseases, and treatments, build a team, and battle using strategic turn-based combat.

title: Gem Beasts Demo
description: Gem beasts is a creature collector, roguelike. Fight and collect other creatures to play as, manage your inventory and explore different build combinations.

title: Shell as Hard as Steel Demo
Beat For Speed Demo
description: Bring your favorite music into Beat For Speed and turn any song into a playable rhythm ride. Ride dynamic tracks, create your own with the Level Editor, and explore community creations on Steam Workshop.

title: AMEN: MAYHEM Demo
description: Fast-paced top-down action with brutal combat and chaotic battles. Pick a character, grab a weapon, and fight your way through the mess. Try different loadouts, adapt to what happens, and make your own kind of mayhem.

title: True Confession Demo
description: Religious guy Henry witnesses violent shootouts and fragments of his past every night in his dreams. In reality, he’s an ordinary man struggling with anger and guilt while visiting his pastor. Fight inside his dreams in this isometric pixel-art shooter and experience his True Confession.

title: Baby Shooter Demo
description: Ready to experience absolute chaos through the eyes of a newborn? In Baby Shooter, a 2D platformer-shooter, blast your way through levels and tough boss fights, destroying anyone and anything standing between you and the heart of a baby girl!

title: 钟馗幸存者 Demo
description: Zhong Kui Survivor Demo unlocks the full Act 1 night-patrol experience. Play as Zhong Kui on haunted routes, facing waves of Chinese spirits with auto-attacking ritual weapons, movement, and upgrade choices. Push the map, light soul lanterns, and challenge the Act 1 ghost king.

title: Corsair Fleet Tides of Plunder Demo
description: ⚓ Start with one ship, plunder the seven seas! Corsair Fleet: Tides of Plunder blends idle progression, crew deck-building and roguelike naval combat in a cozy pixel-art pirate RPG. Send your ships on voyages — your fleet keeps sailing and loot keeps piling up even while you're away.

title: Bloodthrone: Eternal Reign Demo
description: An immortal vampire lord's night begins. Hunt a living village where every victim is a choice — drain them for blood, or raise them as a soldier in your army. Manage your coven, endure the hunters' wrath, and reign across five ages.

title: Pongcremental Demo
description: Pongcremental is an incremental game where you play as the ball of Pong. Eliminate enemies, get stronger, unlock game changing abilities. Hit, destroy, earn, get good. And repeat.

title: Roads of Da Vinci: In Search of Origins Demo
Fantasy Idle RPG Demo
description: From the solo developer of Idle Trillionaire, set in a world of knights, dragons, dungeons, and magic. Purchase cards to earn gold and experience, unlock new quests, and watch your character grow. Every card is hand written with a touch of the developers signature humor.

title: RELICTUM Demo
description: Become the Messenger of God and explore the endless abyss, defeating powerful enemies and bosses to fulfill the divine command in this 2D Metroidvania action adventure.

title: Perfect Wives Next Door Demo
description: Just being invited is enough to enter. Legal access to homes and surveillance control──your privileges as "Veil" building's maintenance technician. Among residents, that gentle, lonely married woman is exactly your type, while other women here are showing interest in you too...

title: Rustborn Demo
description: Fight endless machine hordes, salvage scrap, build powerful weapon combinations, and survive in this fast-paced mech survivor roguelite.

title: Tight Lines Demo
description: Fish solo or with friends on lakes that contain deep simulations of real-life fish behavior. Every species has its own habits and hiding spots. Learn what triggers a bite, refine your technique, and test your skill against the lakes' legendary monsters or while you manage your own fishing pond.

title: Among Shadows Demo
description: Celestial Fall is an intense blend of fast-paced combat and identity-based deduction. You are sent to stop a deadly infection from spreading across a corrupted land, but traitors have infiltrated your team. With the Blood Moon rising, can you escape from this place under the conspiracy?

title: Black Lotus Demo
description: Play Chapter 1 of Black Lotus in this demo and save your progress as you play. Transported into a dark fantasy novel, Lin Tangtang must navigate dangerous missions, tangled relationships, and fate-changing choices.

title: TEST 5 Demo
description: Act as AIB Test 5, operate within a surreal virtual skyscraper, wield an extensive arsenal of weapons and gear, defeat hostiles, collect loot, and complete an infinite stream of test trials.

title: Auspicious Clouds
description: A unique turn-based game featuring Auspicious Cloud Cards. Wield the power of the Five Elements to unleash skills and vanquish foes. Unlock a vast roster of character skills, collect Cultivation Orbs, and devise your own one-of-a-kind tactics to conquer every opponent.

title: Kitty Kitty Bounce Bounce Demo
description: Good old-fashioned arcade game in which you bop around a kitty using various cushions. Your goal is to break all breakable block without falling onto the floor. Difficulty levels, in-game shop where you can buy pick-me-ups with points you get for destruction, cute art and soundtrack, and much more!

title: Spada Demo
description: SPADA é um jogo que desafia seus reflexos e sua precisão. Entre no ritmo de um combate brutal, onde qualquer erro pode ser fatal. Seu verdadeiro oponente é o limite da sua própria habilidade. Gerencie seus recursos, sobreviva à arena e lute pela sua liberdade!

title: 4:AM Demo
description: Hide. Solve. Run. Survive. In this vertical slice of 4:AM's near-future dystopia, Aila must rely on observation and ingenuity to escape a world where light is lethal. Duplicate objects from the environment and adapt under pressure in this dark cinematic stealth adventure demo.

title: The Brothers Karamazov Demo
description: Three brothers come back to the house of a father none of them loves. The first two books of Dostoevsky's novel, word for word, free. Your progress carries over to the full game.

title: Incremental Heaven Demo
description: Start as a tiny mech, spread as a cosmic parasite, or rewrite reality as a living cursor. Destroy enemies, unlock hundreds of upgrades, evolve through massive transformations, and grow from scrapyard survivor to universe-shaping power.

title: Duck Duck Gone Demo
description: Hide a rubber duck in plain sight, then hunt down everyone else’s in this chaotic online party game for up to 8 players. Paint it, resize it, fool your friends and pray the reveal camera is kind.

title: Neuville Demo
description: During the day, explore tile by tile and build your defenses to survive waves of enemies each night. Stay alive as long as possible to discover why humans are unwelcome on Neuville.

title: Canvas City Demo
description: Canvas City is a turn-based tactics RPG of rebellion on roller skates. Lead a crew of skaters and street artists rising up against an oppressive regime. Each map is a battleground and a canvas, where your actions shift control, leave your mark, and shape the city’s future.

title: DinoSWORD Demo
description: Who will win the fight, a T-REX with a BROADSWORD or a PTERODACTYL with a KATANA? Find out as you choose from an ample roster of prehistoric combatants, including species like Spinosaurus, Brontosaurus, Stegosaurus, Triceratops and many more!

title: Glowlings Demo
description: Deepdive in a top-down rougelite and defend yourself as a Glowling against the machines that have come to life. Collect the Scrap from you dead enemys to build new items and weapons. Find new ways to combine your character, items and weapons to develope powerful synergys.

title: The Dream Of Winning The Lottery Demo
description: Find clues to lucky numbers through prophetic dreams and various events, then buy lottery tickets each week. Keep chasing the jackpot and fulfill your dream in this simple 2D point-and-click lottery simulation game.

title: BOMBACON! Demo
description: Join a chaotic 3-player co-op bomb defusal game as three pigs: one mute, one blind, and one deaf! Build your own communication chain through notes and voice chat to solve 6 unique modules. Try the demo now and test your friendship! 🐷💣

title: The Last Spire 2 Demo
description: Defend the Last Spire in this strategic spell-building incremental. Unlock powerful spells, evolve them, discover game-changing mutations, and exploit elemental weaknesses to survive endless waves of monsters.

title: GLITCHED MATRIX: Prototype Lab - Beta
description: Every experience is made to be different in Matrix OS: Arcade Evolution. This will be a generous demo.

title: Crack That Smile Demo
description: A punchy, low-effort incremental game where you hover over frozen ice to shatter it and free adorable emojis. Upgrade your freezing-crushing power, break harder ice, feel invincible, and rescue every emoji collection in this short, packed game!

title: Soul Surge Demo
description: Soul Surge is a third-person action roguelite, with ARPG and bullet hell elements. Fight your way through Ryn’s subconscious, defeat her inner demons, by unleashing powerful combination attacks fueled by Ryn’s core memories. Wield the power of memories, equip your emotions and face the corruption.

title: Pluffy Nightmare Demo
description: Blast through a surreal nightmare in this fast-paced roguelike FPS with funny weapons! In Pluffy Nightmare, your mind is dragged into a doll´s body to battle possessed plushies, dolls, and toys in bizarre fantasy worlds.

title: Shiba Heroes Demo
description: Choose a Shiba hero, upgrade your battle deck, level up and progress through the map taking right decisions and winning turn-based card battles to unravel the mystery of the meme curse.

title: CHROMATIC CRISIS Demo
description: CHROMATIC CRISIS is a colorful metroidvania with unique mechanics! Try to get out of these artificial biomes and save the colors of the real world!

title: Twin-stick Japanese Demo
description: Choose a deck, blast words, and turn correct answers into power. Shooting a word presents four choices. Pick the right one to earn a power-up and strengthen your build. Survive increasingly intense waves while mastering your Japanese, with study progress saved between runs.

title: Benders In Space Demo
description: Mine the belts, colonize distant worlds, and choose your allies as three rival factions fight over a fractured frontier, then prestige through five starships and lead a joint fleet against the invading Dominion.

title: Relaxy Rubber Ball Simulator Demo
description: A game about being a ball and relax. Relaxy Rubber Ball Simulator gives you an out of the world experience of the life of a happy ball. Do nothing or do the ball thing.

title: Beefy Boi Demo
description: A job simulator horror. Gather ingredients, assemble orders, and hand them to customers. Your boss is a massive meat monster and we intentionally broke him. Pay your bills when you get back to your room.

title: ALL OUT WAR Demo
description: ALL OUT WAR is an autobattler RTS, where you create the army, and the units fight autonomously! There are many different robots at your disposal, each with their own designs and quirks. The secret is choosing the right units at the right time, to obliterate the enemy.

title: Gobs & Gears Demo
description: The Gob King wants his bomb. He wants it NOW. A factory-builder about goblins, rickety conveyor belts, and one very impatient king. Find your lost factory in the Fog, wire it back together, and build the BIG BOOM.

title: Tamara Demo
developer: David kay, Mateusz Sliwa, Patryk Grandt

title: Lost Soul Demo
description: Lost soul is a roguelite action-platformer. inspired by deadcells, and hades. You'll explore an ever-changing Tower with a 2D souls-lite combat.

title: Menthal Demo
description: Menthal is a first-person horror game where you are the test subject. Take experimental medicine, endure the side effects, and try to survive what happens next.

title: Castle Away Demo
developer: René Slump, Sim Kaart, Matthijs Koster

title: Fab.exe Demo
description: Take charge of an aging semiconductor fab and guide its first wafers safely to shipment. Place tools, read the queues, clear bottlenecks and trace a yield alarm. This free demo includes the first five story missions.

title: Breakin Mad Demo
description: A brick breaker without a paddle. Launch the ball, redirect its trajectory, create massive chain reactions, and destroy the Core before your last shot.

title: Pet The Damn Cat! Demo
description: A cozy tactical clicker where you pet cats and get rewarded for it. Master the perfect pat, dodge cucumbers and vacuums, dress your favorite cats in tiny costumes, brew questionable catnip, and rescue a shelter full of strays into your forever home. What else could you want?

title: Xydorth Demo
description: The demo represents roughly the first half hour of the game, featuring all the mechanics that are also found in the main game.

title: 姑苏恋语 Demo
description: 《姑苏恋语》是一款极具特色的视觉小说游戏，将恋爱、喜剧元素巧妙融合，以苏州为故事发生地，为玩家带来一场别具一格的本土恋爱体验。 游戏采用独特的二次元画风，画面细腻真实，对苏州的实景进行高度还原，每一个场景都仿佛能让人感受到这座江南古城的独特韵味，大眩光和大对比度的场景，增强视觉冲击力和真实感。

title: 健身小狗 試玩版
description: GymPup is a furry-themed romance narrative game that combines desktop idle gameplay with visual novel storytelling. Accompany the protagonist on a journey of growth and transformation, witnessing both physical and emotional development along the way.

title: Baseball Empire Demo
description: The demo covers the first in-game year.

title: Knock Twice Demo
description: Garland Court, 1974. The building has one rule: if someone knocks twice — only twice — do not answer, do not speak. Four apartments, fourteen nights, twelve endings. You never see the thing in the hall. You only decide whether to open the door. Headphones required.

title: Sevendays Demo
description: Sevendays Demo is a single-player RPG where your dialogue choices with different characters branch into unique endings. This free demo covers most of the first character’s story, showcasing core gameplay and early plot content.

title: Endfaryth Demo
description: In 5135, a substance called Ash poisoned the sky, and an endless snowstorm consumed the world. You awaken from darkness with no memory of your past. Faced with fragile warmth, will you forget what was and cling to the present, or venture into the frozen wilds to uncover the truth of who you were?

title: Into the Planet's Flesh Demo
description: Hatch parasites and infest the earth in this incremental game. Create a gruesome spectacle as your colony spreads like a disease through the planet. Discover what happens when your parasites VENTURE TOO DEEP.

title: 弾幕の戦乙女 -Barrage of Valhalla- Demo
description: The free demo of Barrage of Valhalla. Play every mission of the first area — the Misty Floating Citadel — as the Bowman. Weave through barrages, hunt loot, and prepare between sorties: a hands-on taste of the two pillars, the skill to dodge and the joy to grow.

title: Heroic Hop: The Colorful World of Blocks and the ChromaLords Demo
Chichi's Desktop Journey Demo
description: Welcome to the world of Chichi the little mouse! Chichi is a tiny traveler with big dreams, and their only piece of luggage is a little ball. Keep Chichi company while you work or study, and help make their journey more colorful, cozy, and full of surprises.

title: Oil Sheik: Dominion Demo
description: Play the campaign's opening: hold Nabataea against the rebels, ride with the convoy to the signal beneath the desert, and master the stock board in the Nabataea Free Zone. The full game continues where the demo ends.

title: A Quiet Place Between Us Demo
Coffin Hunter Demo
description: Start in Tier 2 of Coffin Hunter. Hunt for coffins, harvest rare souls, and grow stronger with ship upgrades, crafted weapons, drones, and tools. Battle against the Gobraaz, the Jingcha, and Bounty Hunters, then survive the Tier 2 Challenge by defeating their Champion.

title: Code My Robot Vacuum Demo
description: Code My Robot Vacuum (Demo) lets you learn the basics of coding while cleaning! Program your robot vacuum through introductory tutorial levels, solving simple cleaning challenges and learning core mechanics. Navigate early puzzles and get a taste of logical problem-solving.

title: Dice in Wonderland Demo
description: Roll dice into poker hands in this roguelike deckbuilder. Forge every die yourself and stack chips × mult until the Queen's own scorekeeper gives up counting. A cruel, twisted Wonderland under the Cheshire Cat's watchful grin — one more run, all the way down.

title: Duelike Demo
description: Duelike is a roguelike deckbuilding card game featuring poker-inspired mechanics and online PvP battles. Build unique decks, make strategic decisions, and compete in ever-changing card battles. Experience the core gameplay in this demo version.

title: Doctor Plague Demo
description: It tells the legendary story of Doctor Plague, who slays demons and cures diseases. Medical skills are honed through battles, and knife skills are refined through treating patients. The combat part adopts Metroidvania, while the healing part uses rhythm game.

title: Picronix 2 Demo
description: Relax and engage your mind with these relaxing logic puzzles. Train your brain and find your inner peace.

title: Hop's Awakening! Demo
description: Blast through colorful hand-drawn pixel worlds in this action-packed cute 'em up! Play the opening stage plus an alternate Route C stage, battle challenging bosses, discover unique weapons, collect food for score multipliers, and unleash powerful Super Weapons.

title: Boom Cube Demo
description: Break away from traditional 2D Tetris. Control axis-based blocks in a 10×10×10 cubic space, clear lines by filling full rows or columns, and experience the all-new thrill of 3D block elimination.

title: Liar's Table Demo
description: Liar's Table is a card-based Roguelike game. Play cards that may be true or false — deceive your enemies, conceal your own intentions, and seek out their weaknesses. Under the table, no one is innocent — only those whose bluffs haven't yet been called.

title: Flip & Conquer Multiplayer Demo
description: A coin decides every battle — you decide everything else: the target, the stake, the cards you spring. Not luck, nerve. Wager one square or your whole border and take the map. Learn it in one round, play it all night — up to 8 empires online, or a branching campaign solo.

title: LIMINAL Demo
description: Enter LIMINAL's systemic core: explore a seeded world, establish a Root Beacon, put autonomous harvesters to work, recover physical salvage, and cross a threshold into somewhere impossible.

title: Lucky Hell Demo
description: The hidden casino opens for one night. Roll your dice into poker hands, twist the odds with charms and engravings, and see how deep the stairs go. Free demo — the first 12 stages.

title: BEADS Demo
description: BEADS is a cozy digital perler-bead game. Fill in the picture one bead at a time—perfect for slow, quiet sessions when you just want to zone out.

title: Guttering Light Demo
description: A roguelike deckbuilder in a vault that is running out of light. Descend four depths as one of four heroes, building a deck from cards, stones and draughts as you go. Your torch is a resource — let it gutter and experience greater pain. The lords of the vault stand between you and victory.

title: Colorizing: Sunrise Demo
description: A relaxing color-by-numbers game with a wide variety of pictures for every taste.

title: Nostra Culpa Demo
description: A first-person philosophical horror exploration game where you journey through Hell and uncover the stories of those who dwell within.

title: マジカルラプチャー Demo
Mirror Backrooms Demo
description: Demo — Compare two Backrooms corridors side by side and find what changed. Up to eight things are wrong in each room — call them out with a sonic ring, one shot, refunded every time you are right. Three shared hearts, a hundred floors, then endless. Solo, or online with voice chat.

title: Galaxy Adventures 3D Demo
description: Join Mario Jr. on this galactic adventure liberating worlds from the evil LordUsury. A 3D adventure video game with a fun soundtrack and a welcoming environment. The game is 100% indie developed by a single person over 5 years.

title: Gank Demo
description: A love letter to all fans out there who enjoy DOTA or LoL - a MOBA card game! Though designed for quick online matches, we also squeezed in a roguelite campaign! This demo allows free unlimited play of the tutorial and prologue chapter, as well as unlimited matches using the same exact team drafts.

title: Just Press Keys Demo
description: Imagine if TETRIS and a keyboard had a baby. It would be Just Press Keys. It's a short typing game made of 1 endless level and 6 additional levels with unique features and bosses. This is the ultimate game about typing! And you have to just press keys. The demo only includes the Endless Level.(*/0\*)

title: CHIP & THE RED STORM Demo
description: Run as fast as you can through this fast-paced 2D side-scrolling platformer! Deal with wacky enemies and bosses covering every track of your path. Sit down by yourself or with friends in this pixel 80's-90's inspired indie game and seal your decided fate of their world.

title: Shadow Monarch´s Rise Demo
description: Shadow Monarch’s Rise is a soullite action RPG with fast, skill-based combat, many many quests, hidden treasures, epic bosses, and character progression. A Skilltree with epic Powers to unlock! Future updates will include more Skills, areas & Bosses etc.

title: Pengu Pult Demo
description: Grab your hammer and launch yourself through ice and snow in PenguPult! Climb the mountain with precise jumps or slip and fall back to the bottom. If you crave a challenge you need to try this!

title: Nebula Blink Demo
description: Real-time space-fleet tactics where formation, facing and weapon arcs decide every engagement. Command 35 operations from both sides of a galactic war.

title: MUTAGEN Demo
description: Explore a lush, interconnected alien ecosystem that reshapes itself each time you die. Absorb mutations from your fallen kin to reach new areas and adapt to your surroundings. Study the environment to find your own solutions, and unearth the planet's many secrets.

title: Thornwake: Forest Adventure Demo
description: A hand-drawn 16-bit action platformer. Run, climb and vine-swing through 40 levels of autumn woods, sunken swamps and frozen peaks, mixing sword-and-shield melee with four elemental spells to cleanse a corrupted forest and rescue the Keeper it took.

title: Orby vs Rects Demo
description: Break the Rects. Collect Recties. Upgrade. Repeat. Orby vs Rects is a retro-inspired shooter that captures the spirit of Arkanoid and Tetris classics, while delivering fast-paced bullet-hell action.

title: 知夏 Demo
description: 你将扮演一个被AI淘汰的程序员，回到那个停滞的小县城，与那个等了你十二年的女孩一起去寻找，从所有人记忆里消失的发小和尘封的往事，你们追查的不仅仅是真相，还是被AI一起困住的那个夏天、那座小城、那段永远不会结束的等待。

title: Insomnia Club Demo
description: Insomnia Club is a dark, grounded emotional visual novel about early-adult confusion, social issues, intimacy, and self-identity. You play as a long-term insomniac employee whose life gradually slips out of control as reality tightens around you.

title: Lineup, Dark Lord! : Auto Battler Demo
Cat Caffeine Demo
description: A cozy idle ASMR cat café that lives on your screen. Serve customers and decorate your café while you work or relax.

title: Astral Forge: Desktop Alchemist Demo
description: A fantasy desktop idle companion. Everyday typing turns into magical energy to craft mystical artifacts. Enjoy casual async social features, and collect & trade relics on the Steam Market. Turn daily work and study into a magical alchemy journey!

title: Prigod Idle Demo
description: Build a hero and send it to battle. An idle auto-battler RPG where your build does the fighting: 20 heroes, deep gear and gem crafting, pet battles, dungeons, seasonal events and 22 minigames. Play it active or let it idle. Pay once, no ads, no daily chores.Test the demo before you buy the real game

title: Broadside Bash Demo
description: Broadside Bash Demo具备游戏的核心玩法，但是在内容量上还有待丰富。您可以体验到与兄弟们激情对射的快感，享受船只碎片飞溅时的视觉冲击，我们会持续丰富游戏内容，修复游戏Bug，优化联机体验。

title: Punch Upon a Time Demo
description: Punch Upon a Time is a team-based party fighter inspired by Smash Bros where you take on rounds of modes, mini-games, and combat alongside your friends. Assemble a squad of the biggest fairy tale names to punch, dunk, fly, score, and sumo your way to victory as the LAST TEAM STANDING.

title: AVIK Demo
description: AVIK is an atmospheric space sandbox where you explore space. Following a recent tragedy, you must begin your story from scratch, unraveling the mysteries of the past while upgrading your spaceship, mining resources, crafting new parts, and fighting for your survival.

title: Brain Bomb Demo
description: Concepts are bombs. Association is death. An cult-like anti-utopian psychological horror puzzle game. The subject has a concept bomb implanted in brain. If a subject thinks of the [Fuse Word], their head detonates. You, as the "cognitive bomb defuser", dismantling the deadly "brain bomb".

title: Mado Marks Demo
description: Three students discover a classroom room that shouldn’t exist... When they leave, one of them disappears forever. A short demo of a psychological horror VN about memory, proof, and erasure.

title: Fangjie:Shattered Altars Demo
description: Become an adventurer set on restoring order in a shattered voxel world. This demo covers the opening hours: procedural exploration, class and skill trees, action combat, up to a boss fight against the Stone Guardian.

title: The Finest Spark Demo: First Flight
Blastlane Racers Demo
description: Explosive arcade combat racing. Fight your way through the 6-race demo championship, unleash powerful weapons, and upgrade your car between races. Race solo or challenge your friends in chaotic 4-player split-screen.

title: MSO FreeCell Arena Demo
description: Free Demo of MSO FreeCell Arena — multiplayer FreeCell where everyone races the same deal. Race the Arena Queue live, play the worldwide Daily Challenge, and take on every difficulty tier. Watch live leaderboards fill in. The full game adds hardcore mode, accounts, and the competitive layer.

title: No Quarter Demo
description: Sail as a pirate across a cutout of Caribbean ocean. Trim to the wind, rake enemy hulls with broadsides, and haul plunder home in a hold you have to pack yourself.

title: Mine Collector Demo
description: Mine Collector is a casual collection game inspired by Gold Miner.

title: Taskbar Chickens Demo
description: Cute little chickens are wandering around on your taskbar! Play with them, pet them and use their products to craft new tools, unlock new skills and get richer! While you're working on other stuff, they will accompany you on your taskbar.

title: Incremental RTS Demo
description: Grow your army from single scouts to floods of tanks, artillery, and engineered mega units. Build factories, choose upgrades and watch hundreds of units collide in wild auto-battles. Hold the line against relentless enemy surges and scale fast enough to survive.

title: Tensio Demo
description: A physics climber where the level is an instrument. Every string you pull sings and every string you overpull snaps for good. One life, no checkpoints, and a very long way down.

title: Scam Artist Demo
description: Build your empire of scamming in this idle building game. Place down slot machines that never pay out, sell trading card packs that never have any hits and slowly build up your riches to upgrade your apartment until it looks like the most professional scam operation ever!

title: QBLOX Demo
description: QBLOX is a fast, minimal 3D puzzle experience where you shift axes between two walls to control falling blocks. This demo features the first 5 stages, introducing core mechanics like axis switching, wall transitions, and clean cinematic camera flips.

title: MacroNode Demo
description: MacroNode is a Windows visual automation tool where you build macros by wiring nodes on a canvas. It handles mouse and keyboard input, image, color and OCR screen detection, branching, variables, hotkeys, letting you create real programmable workflows without writing any code.

title: The Unworty Demo
description: What if Hell made a mistake? Based on the testimony of a man who survived clinical death, this cinematic psychological horror challenges you to confront your fears and fight your way back to life, while something lurking in the darkness does everything it can to keep you among the damned forever.

title: Metro Anomaly Demo
description: Watch the behavior of the office clerks closely and find the one who is merely pretending to be human. You have only one bullet to survive this cycle. Make a mistake, and the anomaly will attack you.

title: Duco Demo
description: Duco is a survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world, built around card-based roguelike mechanics. Draw from location-based decks to gather resources, loot, craft, build, and survive. Unlock new characters and maps, combine them with traits to create unique runs.

title: Six Feet Under: The Mortician’s Last Stand Demo
description: Six chambers. They fire in order. You decide what each one does. The first act of a hand-drawn Western horde shooter: four nights on Boot Hill, the whole cylinder to engrave, and a judge at the end of it who does not stay down. Everything you bury comes back up.
developer: Werner Viljoen, Rogue Dog Indie Games

title: Heatwarped Demo
description: Ratfield sits atop an underground racing scene. Conquer the streets by warping the odds in your favor. Customize your ride to the max, meet up with other racers from your pda's racing forum to compete, and build respect.

title: F Of X Demo
description: Embark on a journey through a digital world of functions, solving mathematical puzzles to move platforms and conquer platforming challenges. Test your logic to transcend as the Master of Functions.

title: Archer of Den Demo
description: The evil in the air has it's grip on everything. So it's up to you and your trusty bow to put a stop to it. You will travel a diverse set of lands to accomplish your goal. in this Action Adventure you have to do what it takes, run, shoot, slide, bomb , and even fly to bring back peace.

title: Pinata Smash: Incremental Circus Demo
description: Smash piñatas, collect candy, run the show! A fast active incremental game where the crowd throws for you. Upgrade your arena, gamble at the casino, and grow a number that refuses to stop!

title: Eternal Angler Demo
description: A surreal multiplayer fishing game where you catch strange creatures hidden across fragmented dimensions.

title: Idle Casino Empire Demo
description: A free prologue to an idle casino tycoon. Build a Downtown floor, hire staff, research upgrades, and play five of your own games in Owner Mode. Use the Owner's Edge to nudge reels and peek at hidden cards, then choose when to start Last Call.

title: Gendo The Gatherer Demo
description: A cozy life sim where you forage, cook and serve your way through Gendo's journey navigating an abundant, ever changing landscape. After long days of gathering goodies, return to your cozy home to prepare, cook and serve your dishes to the local townsfolk. Join Gendo in his life in the countryside.

title: BABA YAGA: Whispers of the BOOM DEMO
description: Escape from Baba Yaga in a surreal forest inspired by Slavic mythology. This demo features a tutorial map that introduces the core mechanics of combat, exploration, and magical glyphs. Map progress is not saved in the demo.

title: Leadbelly Demo
description: A human brain wired into a war tank, and a debt to collect. Fight through PowderKeg territory to their Lieutenant. Incapacitated enemies aren't dead — their brains are exposed, and yours for the taking. The opening stretch of a hand-drawn roguelike deckbuilder.

title: Wuwei Cultivation Demo
description: A minimalist idle cultivation RPG. Train through nine realms, explore wilds and forbidden lands, defeat bosses for breakthrough pills, master eight disciplines, collect gear, and reincarnate to improve your aptitudes. Features auto-battles, offline progress, and local saves.

title: DREAMFEAR Demo
description: Escape the nightmare filled with your own fears using various weapons and upgrades in a fast-paced, surreal roguelite. Can you survive in your own mind?

title: The Last Call Demo
description: Every run starts the same. Never ends that way. Arena, corrupted monsters, zero grind. The Last Call throws you in and lets you figure it out. Tactical combat, short sessions, honest difficulty. Only your skill matters.

title: Kart Racing Strike Demo
description: Welcome to Kart Racing Strike, an arcade racing game where every corner, boost, and split-second decision can make the difference between victory and defeat.

title: War Crimes Co. Demo
description: Try the free demo of War Crimes Co., a sarcastic war-funding automation tycoon. Exploit workers, manufacture weapons, fund wars, and turn nonsense into disaster!

title: Chancess Demo
description: CHANCESS is a turn-based strategy roguelike where you control a Prince on an 8x8 chessboard using random movement cards to outsmart enemy pieces, survive tactical encounters, and adapt to unpredictable challenges.

title: Click Dystopia Demo
description: Click Dystopia is a casual clicker Incremental game, where you click a button to slay virtual people for cash.

title: Market Manager Simulator Demo
description: Build and manage your own market. Fill the shelves, set prices, serve customers, manage online orders and grow your business. Hire employees, check stocks and turn your market into a large business.

title: Spiritura Demo
description: Spiritura is an atmospheric open-world survival crafting game with light RPG elements, exploration, and base building. Forge your own path through a mysterious, procedurally generated land, utilizing diverse combat skills to survive the threats of the wild as you uncover the secrets of the world.

title: Shadow War Demo
description: "Shadow War" is a 2D action game focused on combat with a Japanese-inspired atmosphere. Enjoy a variety of combat actions by combining normal attack combos, parries, guarding, and skills that consume Spirit.

title: Brimir: Pilgrimage to the Heart Demo
Timberworks Demo
description: Timberworks is an incremental factory automation and management game. Start with a small sawmill, automate production, expand your railway network, and build a vast industrial empire.

title: Outpost Simulator (Demo)
description: The world ended. Build a shelter for survivors, serve their needs to earn money, and defend your outpost from raids. Upgrade your base and your gear, and get a taste of rebuilding the wasteland. Welcome to Outpost Simulator DEMO.

title: Beat Weaver Demo
description: 3D multi-track rhythm action with space-time bending mechanics that reward your style as much as your precision. Hit notes and switch tracks to add instruments to the mix. Become a remix machine, enter the flow state and uniquely approach each song of a highly replayable, genre-defying soundtrack.

title: RippleLoop Demo
description: Chain together stone skips in this relaxing incremental game. Launch, bounce across the water, upgrade, and go further with every throw. Buy new upgrades and powers to become the best stone skipper.

title: Deskbound Raiders Demo
description: An ultimate slacking combo fusing action, idle growth, and desktop pet! Tuck it into your screen corner to start hardcore looting. Lead your Little Triangle against scheming animal factions and let your desktop host an epic underground adventure of conspiracy and treasure!

title: Bringers of Darkness Demo
description: Fight for the forces of darkness in this free demo of Bringers of Darkness. Play as the Succubus, master 6 unique abilities, and battle through the armies of light in Pinewood Village.

title: Football Manager: Auto Chess Demo
description: A football management game mixed with collection career play. You manage a themed club, schedule training, recruitment and league fixtures, then drag coach cards to command near-realtime matches as you climb from lower leagues to bigger stages.

title: Circulo Demo
description: Experience the geometric chaos of Circulo for free. Survive increasingly intense waves, collect resources, upgrade your character and experience persistent progression in this limited version of the full game.

title: Crease Demo
description: Fold the paper into shape. A cozy grid puzzler about creasing a sheet of paper until it matches the target exactly. 100+ levels, with fun mechanics.

title: 挂机英雄传 Demo
description: Idle Heroes Saga is an idle game where you collect heroines, form a team, and embark on adventures.

title: A Game About Being A Parrot Demo
Synemancy
description: Sling spells to overwhelm your opponents in card-based online duels, or immerse in a deep single-player story about the pursuit of knowledge and power, where every choice matters. Stake your very mind and become a Synemancer!

title: Whispering Eclipsia Demo
description: Investigate the mysterious Woods Lane Bungalow, uncover terrifying secrets, and survive the opening chapter of this first-person psychological horror experience.

title: Senpo Mahjong Demo
description: "This is not cheating—it's magic!" A free taste of Senpo Mahjong. Pick a partner from 8 characters and play unlimited matches against three CPU opponents. See through hands, control draws, boost your score—Skills cost MP, so timing your trump card decides it. No sign-up, fully offline.

title: Green Breach Demo
description: Navigate the dark corridors of a doomed space mining ship in this atmospheric sci-fi survival horror game. Search for resources, solve deck-wide puzzles, and manage your survival against persistent, lethal threats.

title: Avidy Demo
description: This is a Rogue-like action-adventure game. The protagonist, as an outsider in a remote town, is accidentally involved in a mysterious ritual.

title: Record of Chaos - Korean Chapter - Demo
description: Record of Chaos is a solo-developed roguelike deckbuilding card game inspired by Korean folklore and traditional Korean imagery.

title: MechBrawl Demo
description: Mecha Brawl: A pure tactics game made by a father & son! Packed with a kid's wild imagination, unique designs, and fun mechanics. Enjoy easy-to-learn, direct battles rich in strategic counters! Come help us expand this mech universe!

title: 宿の掟 / Rules of the Inn Demo
description: You know the rules. You still can't be sure if what you just saw was wrongness or your nerves. Take a room at an inn on the border of the afterlife and judge what slips in each night, obeying one rule more than the last. The demo runs to the third night. Past it, the rules alone will not save you.

title: Epitome Demo
description: Welcome to the system of Epitome. Explore a world woven from the threads of reality.Here, us, the Archons, my creations, rule over their unique realms, shaping and disorting them according to their desires.This is no mere adventure - enter Epitome and strive to become an Archon.
